comment.body_excerpt: ## Investigation: CJK private finals bypass stranded-reply detection ### Root cause confirmed The sentence-terminator regex in `src/auto-r ... fically `SENTENCE_TERMINATOR_REGEX` (line ~6486 in bundled output) and `countSentenceLikeTerminators()`. Tested on OpenClaw `2026.7.1-2`.
